title: Rollback 回溯
description: From ,《Relics of the Fading City》Special: Minefading，this module allows players to return to a past time period when they die.
body:
**Minefading** — A Special from *Relics of the Fading City* While this mod was originally designed for a specific modpack, I'd love to see it adopted in more modpacks — provided proper credit is given to the original author and commercial use is strictly prohibited. This mod reworks the death mechanic: instead of respawning at their spawn point, players are rolled back to a previous point in time upon death. It also packs a variety of unique features and mechanics: | Name | Type | Function | Notes | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Inhaler** | Inhaler | Used to activate the Core. | Must be held in the main hand. | | **Disconnection Core** | Core | Instantly saves the game. | Must be held in the off-hand. | | **Chronos Core** | Core | Instantly saves the game and slows down time for a duration. The game auto-saves again once the effect wears off. | Must be held in the off-hand. | | **Molting Core** | Core | Instantly triggers a rollback. | Must be held in the off-hand. | | **Tower Core** | Core | Destroys the player. | Must be held in the off-hand.

⚠ **WARNING: This permanently forces the player into Spectator Mode (irreversible)!** | | **Sand Core** | Core | Marks a creature, bringing it to the player's side during a rollback. | Must be held in the off-hand.

Only one creature-marking Core may be active at a time. | | **Causality Core** | Core | Marks a creature. Upon the player's death, the marked creature takes damage equal to the player's max health, while the player is healed. | Must be held in the off-hand.

Only one creature-marking Core may be active at a time. | | **Myriad Core** | Core | Marks a creature. Whenever the marked creature takes damage, the items in the player's main hand and off-hand are modified. | Must be held in the off-hand.

Only one creature-marking Core may be active at a time. | | **Stasis Core** | Core | Marks a creature, temporarily disabling its AI. | Must be held in the off-hand.

Only one creature-marking Core may be active at a time. | | **Countdown** | Mod Config | At the start of each new day, the on-screen display changes from "Day X" to "X Days Remaining." | ⚠ **WARNING: Once the countdown reaches zero, the player is permanently forced into Spectator Mode (irreversible)!** | **Credits & Special Thanks** - My friend **@liyuu** — this mod simply wouldn't exist without them. - My friend **@LAST-iMP** — for teaching me how to build mods from source. - The team behind the ***Relics of the Fading City*** series. - Everyone who plays this mod. And a special shoutout to: - **Minecraft** — the legendary game that made all of this possible. - **Katana Zero** — a major inspiration behind some of the content and mechanics. - **CurseForge, Modrinth, and MC百科 (MCMod)** — without these platforms, players would never have discovered my work. --- *This mod's source code is open-source and available on GitHub.*
